## What changed

- [ ] Scope stays within the intended task/theme
- [ ] No unrelated refactors, cleanup, or feature drift

## Validation

- [ ] Ran the smallest relevant validation for this change
- [ ] Validation result is noted in the PR description

## Docs / config

- [ ] `docs/current-progress.md` or `docs/current-dev-setup.md` updated if behavior/setup changed
- [ ] `.env.example` updated if config surface changed

## Hygiene

- [ ] No local-only or generated files were committed (`.omc/`, `.sisyphus/`, `storage/`, logs, build output)
- [ ] No secrets or machine-specific paths were added
